findings.title: Idle App Service plans
findings.detail: Three production app service plans remain at P2v3 while CPU averages under fifteen percent; consolidation or down-tier preserves headroom.

findings.title: Blob lifecycle
findings.detail: Telemetry archives stay in hot tier after ninety days; policy recommends automated cool tier transition with compliance sign-off.

findings.title: Hub egress charges
findings.detail: Spoke VNets route inspection traffic through hub NVA before Internet breakout; FinOps tags attribute shared egress proportionally.
